about_the_game:
Are there ever enough pockets in your life?

Ever fallen in love with a dress, only to realize, heartbreakingly, that it has no pockets?
Remember those pants with pockets so tiny, they couldn’t hold anything, not even a hair tie?

Yeah. We’ve all been there.

This is the place to talk about POCKETS, and why we still don't have them.

"Where Is My Pocket?" is an interactive story that humorously explores the strange and surprisingly unfair world of pocket inequality. Through playful narration, quirky characters, and colorful voxel art, the game invites you to laugh, learn, and maybe even question your wardrobe choices along the way.
Perfect gift for anyone who want more pockets in their life.

Key Features:

At the heart of the game is The Interviews, where you’ll meet a cast of fictional characters, each with their own take on pocket injustice. Around it are four bite-sized side games:

  • The Pocketless Adventure: Test your survival skills in a world with zero pockets.

  • The Pocket Test: Find out what kind of pocket you'd have in an alternate universe.

  • The Random Pockets: Discover the contents of 10 mysterious pockets.

  • The Pocket Tutorial: Learn how to sew a realistic, functional pocket.

Plus:

  • Uncover the secret story of Spiny the Spider

  • Share your opinion in the optional end-game Pocket Survey, your voice might appear in future updates!

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a fictional narrative about pocket inequality, told through a blend of humor, facts, and storytelling. While the core subject is not inherently mature, the game does include references to real-world topics such as gender roles, women's rights, and social inequality.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon (Universal build)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
